company.shortDescription: Here is a video workspace where teams and friends can connect and work together.
company.description: Here's where teams and friends connect in personal, shareable and flexible video rooms.  Our mission is to create a sense of closeness even for those that are worlds away.  Here does this by letting people build virtual spaces where they video chat, write, draw, screenshare, upload pics and gifs, and move around--all in a web browser.
